validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="seen" expr="[]"/>
  </datamodel>
  <script src="scripts/side-effects.js"/>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <log label="seen" expr="remember('entry')"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="f"/>
  </state>
  <final id="f"/>
</scxml>

primary.message: calls `remember`, which has a side effect

notes: SCXML 1.0 §4.7.3: "The SCXML processor MUST ensure that <log> has no side-effects on document interpretation."
diagnostics.help: log a value without changing anything; move the change into `<assign>` or `<script>`
